## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest python/tests` passes (from the virtual environment)

- [ ] Updated the guide in `docs/` if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Docs use plain English: short steps, no em dashes, no emojis
- [ ] Ran the app with `--mock` (or on hardware) to check it works
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or image location metadata included
